page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top with page number at top left; a large woodcut initial opening the paragraph; no marginal notes.

main_text.p: nant. Homerus, χρησίοις δεπάεσι, aureis pateris.
main_text.head: PETRI RAMI GRAMMATICÆ GRÆCÆ LIBER SECUNDUS, de Verbo.
Cap.1. De communibus verbi affectionibus.
main_text.p: PRO prima persona duali, quoties deest, prima pluralis usurpatur: ut νὼ ἡμαςόμεν, vel ἡμεῖς δύο ἡμαςόμεν, nos duo colimus. Deest autem prima dualis in activo & in passivo activa specie conjugato.

page.notes: The Greek phrases are reproduced approximately from a degraded scan; the initial "P" is a decorated woodcut initial. The catchword "Tem-" is at the lower right. The Greek in the first line and in the paragraph is uncertain: χρησίοις δεπάεσι [?] and νὼ ἡμαςόμεν [?], ἡμεῖς δύο ἡμαςόμεν [?].
